findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_notice, search_guides · Private data: list_cases, get_case, search_guides, explain_contravention_code, calculate_deadlines · Public sink: check_notice.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_notice, search_guides · Private data: list_cases, get_case, search_guides, explain_contravention_code, calculate_deadlines · Public sink: check_notice

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
